target: 749 Capitāneus Coniunctus et Sociī

source: 749 Conjugate Captain and Members
target: 749 Capitāneus Coniunctus et Sociī

source: After her initial shock, Franca pondered thoughtfully, Maybe this idea isn’t so bad after all…
target: Post prīmum stupefactum, Franca dīligenter meditātā est: “Forsitan haec cogitātiō denique nōn tam mala sit…”

source: Wasn’t I originally aiming to become an Iron-blooded Knight? But then there’s Jenna…
target: Nonne initio intendēbam fīeri ēques sanguīne ferreō? Sed ecce, Jenna…

source: Seeing Franca silent, Lumian said with a meaningful smile, “There’s no need to take some things too seriously.
target: Franca silentem reperta, Lumian subrīdē subnuntiāns dīxit: “Nōn est nōbīs necesse quāedam nimis grave tractāre.

source: We’ve all used Lie before and changed our appearances, adapting quite well, haven’t we?
target: Omnēs iam “Lie” ūstāmus et īmāgines nostrās mutāvimus, satis bene accommodātī—nonne?

source: I once even turned into a dog without any lingering trauma.
target: Olim etiam in canem conversus sum, sine ūllo vestigiō trāumatis.

source: As long as it’s not permanent and you can change back, occasionally switching things up can actually be quite fun.
target: Dummōdō non sit perpeūtus et revertī possīs, interdum res mutārī vere delectābilis esse potest.

source: Remember, you’re just acting.”
target: Mementō: tantum fingi nōs.

source: Lumian knew Jenna was already aware that the Demoness pathway led to changes from male to female, whereas the Hunter’s pathway did the opposite, occurring at Sequence 7 Witch and Sequence 4 Iron-blooded Knight.
target: Lumian scīvit Iennam iam nostrānosse viam Demonissae, quā mutātiōs a virō ad fēminam ducēbat, dum via Venatoris contrāriam effēctūs habēbat—in Sequentia VII Maga et Sequentia IV ēques sanguīne ferreō.

source: He also knew Franca suspected Jenna was aware of this.
target: Eum etiam scībat Francam suspicārī Iennam hoc nostrāre.

source: But since the Demoness of Pleasure wanted to continue deceiving herself, he didn’t mind helping a bit by keeping his words vague.
target: At quoniam Demonissa Voluptātis sē fallere perseverāre vellebat, ei nōn molestum erat paulum auxiliārī, verba vagā servāns.

source: “Temporarily… If the ritual of the Demoness of Unaging isn’t evil, I can switch back… A Demoness of Unaging doesn’t sound so evil…”
target: “Temporāriē… Sī rītus Demonissae Immortālīs nōn fuerit malus, revertī possum… Demonissa Immortālīs nōn ita malī vidētur…”

source: Jenna muttered to herself before saying, “! think Lumian’s suggestion is worth considering.”
target: Ienna sibi submurmurāvit antequam dīxit: “Putō cōnsilium Lumiani dīgnum esse cōnsiderandī.”

source: Franca nodded in agreement, on the verge of saying more but stopping herself.
target: Franca annūvit consentientiē, paene plūra dīcere velle sed sē continēbat.

source: Jenna chuckled self-deprecatingly, “I’m only at Sequence 7, just a Witch.
target: Ienna subrīdē dīxit: “Solum in Sequentia VII sum, mera maga.

source: Why am I even considering becoming a demigod and switching back and forth?
target: Cur quidem cogitō semideus fīeri atque vicissim mutārī?

source: “Dammit, it feels like when I first became Showy Diva. Though I was always saving money to pay off debts, it didn’t stop me from dreaming of becoming a famous actress, earning thousands of verl d’or a year, and wondering how I’d spend all that money…”
target: Di immortālēs, quasi tamquam cum prīmō facta essem Diva ostentātrix! Quamquam semper pecuniam servābam ad dēbitō solvendum, nōn impedīt mē somniare fīre actrīcem celeberrimam, annuātim mihi milia “verl d’or” lucrārī, et qua ratiōne totam illam pecuniam expendere?

source: “Me too, me too,” Franca echoed, attempting to explore the feasibility, “If we switch, how do we complete the ritual for a thirty-person Iron-blooded Knight team?”
target: “Et ego quoque, et ego quoque,” Franca replicāvit, conāns possibilitātem explorāre: “Sī mutābimur, quōmodo rītum pro turbā trigintā ēquitōrum sanguīne ferreō perficimus?”

source: Lumian clicked his tongue and continued, “You’d better pray that by then I’ve become an Iron-blooded Knight. Having an Iron-blooded Knight as a team member can significantly reduce the number of people required. Besides, we already work well together.”
target: Lumian linguam concussit et continuāvit: “Oportet orāre, ut eo tempore factus sim ēques sanguīne ferreō. Eques sanguīne ferreō habēns ut membrum turbae, numerum requisītōrum hominum multō attenuāre potest. Praeterea, iam optime simul operāmur.”

source: “Is that possible?” Franca first instinctively felt there was a problem, then muttered to herself, “A ritual is just a ritual. After it’s done, there’s really no need to maintain the previous state, meaning the captain and team members could swap places and form anew team again. What do you call that? That’s called recycling, sustainable development!”
target: “Num hoc possibile est?” Franca primō instinctī sensit quaestiōnem, deinde sibi submurmurāvit: “Rītus modo rītus est. Postquam peractus, nōn est vere necesse pristinum statum servāre, quī significat capitānum et sociōs locīs commūtāre atque turbam novam condere posse. Quid id appellās? Id vocātur re-cyclātiō, progressiō sustenibilis!”

source: The more Franca thought about it, the more excited she became.
target: Quō magis de hoc cōgitābat, eō magis excitāta facta est.

source: “Once I also become an Iron-blooded Knight, Jenna will have two demigod teammates, plus Anthony and Lugano. She shouldn’t need to look for anyone else.
target: “Cum et ego fiam ēques sanguīne ferreō, Ienna duo semideī sodālēs habēbit, praetereā Anthōnius et Lugānus; nōn necesse erit ei aliōs quaerere.

source: “If Ludwig is still with us by then, not having broken his seal, things will be even simpler; we could be his godmothers!”
target: “Sī Ludovīgus tunc adhūc nobiscum fuerit, nec sigillum suum fregit, res etiam simplicīōrēs erunt; possumus eius nutrices esse!”

source: We’d be Ludwig’s godmothers, and Lumian would be his godfather…
target: Nōs Ludovīgī nutrices erimus, et Lumian pater spiritualis eius fīēt…

source: Although this isn’t anything amazing, there are many similar examples, but still.. Jenna glanced at Franca, wanting to remind her of something, but ultimately decided against it.
target: Etsi hoc nōn est quidquam stupendum, multa similia exempla sunt; tamen Ienna Francam aspicuit, aliquid eam admonēre cupiēns, sed tandem id nōn fecit.

source: The more they discussed the details, the more awkward it got, so it was best to leave them be.
target: Quō magis de minutīs disseruērunt, eō magis ineptum factum est, itaque melius erat ea relinquere.

source: With a new strategy to avoid the Demoness of Despair’s ritual, Franca and Jenna felt much better.
target: Nova consilia habentēs ad vitandum rītum Demonissae Desperatiōnis, Franca et Ienna melius se sentsērunt.

source: The former said to Lumian, “There’s a mysticism gathering in a few days.
target: Prīmā Lumian dīxit: “Conventus mysticus intra paucōs diēs fiet.

source: Touch base with the Professor and others to probe whether any members of the Moses Ascetic Order are among them.
target: Contingās cum Professore et aliīs ut investigent, an quid membrī Ordinis Ascēticōrum Mōysis inter eōs sint.

source: It’s not too urgent since Madam Judgement told me that the Tarot Club has informants inside the Moses Ascetic Order who can provide the necessary information.
target: Nōn est nimis urgentis, quoniam Domina Judiciō mihi dīxit Clubum Tarōticum habēre informātōrēs intra Ordinem Ascēticōrum Mōysis, quī necesāriās notitiās praebere possunt.

source: But I’m not sure if that informant belongs to the Trier region and knows the local circumstances, while the Mirror Person, Griffith, is definitely in Trier.”
target: Sed nescio num ille informātōr regiōnī Trēvirensi pertineat et casūs lōcālēs sciat, dum Persona Speculī, Griffith, certē in Trēverī sit.

source: Lumian nodded and replied, “I also need to ask about the Harvest Priest potion formula and corresponding materials.
target: Lumian annūvit et respondentēs dīxit: “Ego etiam quaerere debeō de formula poculī Sacerdōtīs Mēssis et materiīs correspondēntibus.

source: Boosting the team’s strength will help us complete the ritual later.
target: Robōrem turmæ augēre nōs adiuvābit ut rītum postea perficāmus.

source: Jenna listened quietly for a while before interjecting, “Can you help sell that Dream Stealer Beyonder characteristic for me?
target: Ienna quietē aliquandō auscultāvit antequam interponeret: “Potesne mihi auxilium ferre ut illam proprietātem ‘Dream Stealer Beyonder’ vendam?

source: The level of the mysticism gatherings I attend aren’t high enough; nobody can afford an item of that Sequence.”
target: Gradus conventuum mysticōrum quibus adsum nōn satis altus est; nemo rem illius sequentiae comparāre potest.

source: She was thinking about the Demoness of Pleasure potion materials she was about to receive from the Eternal Blazing Sun Church.
target: Rēā cogitābat de materiīs poculī Demonissae Voluptātis, quās ex Ecclesiā Solis Aeternī Flammarum recipere videbātur.

source: Franca’s Pleasure was almost digested, and it wasn’t too good to still owe her companion money.
target: Potio Voluptātis Francae paene completa erat, sed nōn fuit optima rēs quoniam adhūc sociae pecuniam debēbat.

source: After all, she couldn’t use the Dream Stealer Beyonder characteristic herself.
target: Post omnia, ipsa proprietātem “Dream Stealer Beyonder” uti nōn poterat.

source: Lumian could probably guess Jenna’s thoughts, subtly gesturing towards his Traveler’s Bag.
target: Lumian probabiliter intuere potuit Iennās cogitātiōnēs, subtiliter ad sacculum viātōrium suum gesticulāns.

source: His implication was clear: you’ve seen my Iron-blooded Knight and Demoness of Despair potion formulas; how come you haven’t thought about owing me a substantial debt?
target: Intellectus eius manifesto erat: vidistīs formulās poculī meī ēquitōrum sanguīne ferreōrum et Demonissae Desperatiōnis; quare nōnne cōnsēnsistis tē mihi ingentem dēbitum debere?

source: Lumian hoped this approach would make Jenna worry less about owing money, suggesting she borrow more and hire an Artisan to turn the Dream Stealer Beyonder characteristic into a mystical item for use.
target: Lumian sperābat hanc ratiōnem Iennam de pecuniā debendā mīni āctūram, suādens ut amplius fecerit et artificem contratarit, ut proprietātem “Dream Stealer Beyonder” in rem mysticam ad usum converteret.

source: The stronger you are, the easier it is to repay debts!
target: Quō fortiōr es, tanto facilius dēbīta solvere licet!

source: Sitting on the sofa, Jenna scoffed at Franca, gesturing towards Lumian.
target: Sedit in sōfā, Ienna Francam irrīdēns et ad Lumian indicāvit.

source: Her message was clear: when I need to use those two potion formulas to advance, I’ll pay you back!
target: Nuntiō eius manifesto erat: cum illās duās formulās poculī ad progressum adhibere oportēverit, tibi solvam!

source: “I’ll keep an eye out,” Franca said, unaware of the silent conversation between Lumian and Jenna.
target: “Ego cautus ero,” Franca dīxit, nesciēns tacitām conversātiōnem inter Lumian et Ienna.

source: She then said, “We can start gathering some supplementary ingredients for Iron-blooded Knight and Demoness of Despair now, like the mud soaked with soldiers’ blood from a major battlefield and the blood of seven victims of the plague, just to be prepared in case we’re short on time later. Who knows, by then, we might find another way to bypass the plague ritual. Let’s get ready now.”
target: Deinde dīxit: “Nunc possumus colligere supplementāria ingrediēnta pro ēquitōrum sanguīne ferreōrum et Demonissae Desperatiōnis, ut, exempli grātiā, lutum, quod sānge mīlitum ex magnā campō belli saturātum est, atque sānge septem victimārum pestilentiae, ad praeparandum, sī postea tempus deficiat. Quis scit? Forsitan tunc aliam viam inveniēmus ad rītum pestilentiae evādendum. Pariāmus nunc!”

source: Hearing about the preparations for the potion, Lumian nodded and then remembered something.
target: Audītō de praeparātiōnibus poculī, Lumian annūvit atque aliquid meminītus est.

source: He stood up and walked over to the full-length mirror in the room, pressing his right hand against it.
target: Surgēns accessit ad speculum totā longitūdine in camerā, dextram manū illī premēns.

source: He then activated the contract ability from Bloody Jack, sensing the mirror imprints he had left behind.
target: Tum activāvit virtūtem contractūs ex “Bloody Jack”, sentīns imprōntās speculī quās reliquerat.

source: Soon, Lumian used the mirror and its otherworldly connection to detect two imprints from afar—one clear and one blurry.
target: Mox, Lumian speculō et eius nōxum ultra-mundānum nexum adhibuit ut duās imprōntās ab longīnquo detegeret—unam perspicuā et unam obscūrā.

source: The clear one belonged to the full-length mirror in Moran Avigny’s study, while the blurry one changed on its own, shifting positions and making it hard to track.
target: Illa perspicuā pertinēbat ad speculum totum in studio Moran Avigny, dum autem imprōnta obscūra sponte loca mutābat, quā rēs insequi difficilis fēcītur.

source: I can sense it… That must be the imprint on the mirror inside the Blue Avenger’s vault…
target: Id sentīre possum… Illud certe est imprōnta in speculō intra arcā “Blue Avenger.”

source: Using the link between the imprint and myself, no matter how it blurs or shifts, I can teleport directly to it, as long as I can step through the mirror, Lumian pondered for a while but decided not to borrow Franca’s Mirror Cufflink for an experiment.
target: Uti nexū inter imprōntam et mē, quacumque modō illa obscūrētur aut mutētur, directe ad eam transīre possum, dummō cum per speculum ingredī possim; Lumian aliquantulum meditātus est, sed decrevit nōn Francae fibulam speculī ad experimentum mutandam sumere.

source: This was because his spiritual intuition and a warning from fate told him that if he teleported to that imprint now, he might never return, or he might return as Alista Tudor.
target: Hoc erat, quoniam sensus spiritualis eius atque admonitiō vātī fatālēs illi dixerunt, sī nunc ad eam imprōntam translocārētur, fortasse numquam redīret, aut ut Alista Tudor redeātur.

source: Withdrawing his hand, Lumian shared the results of his attempt with Franca and Jenna.
target: Manum revocāns, Lumian eventūs conātī sui cum Franca et Ienna communicāvit.

source: Afterward, Jenna left to visit various hospital morgues.
target: Postea, Ienna discessit ut varia mortuāria hospitāliā visitare dēscīret.

source: This was both to look for opportunities to act as a Witch and to see if there were any bodies that had died from severe contagious diseases.
target: Hoc factum est ut tum occasiones inquīreret ad agendum ut maga, tum ut vidēret an aliqua corpora ex morbis contagiosis gravissimīs mortuāca fuisset.

source: With the Order of All Extinction and the Sick Church not yet eradicated in Trier, there definitely were deaths from the plague, just not many that could cause a widespread outbreak.
target: Cum Ordo Omnium Exstinctionis et Ecclesia Infirmōrum in Trēverīs nōn dēlepta essent, certe mortēs ex pestilentia occurrērunt, sed nōn tantā quātīs ut vasta epidemia efferri possent.

source: Standing by the window, Lumian saw Jenna appear on the street and turned to Franca, saying, “You might have to become a Demoness of Despair, so it would be good to think about how to find an alternative to that ritual.”
target: Stāns ad fēnestram, Lumian Iennam in vīa apparere vidit et ad Francam conversus dīxit: “Forsit necesse erit ut fias Demonissa Desperatiōnis; itaque bene esset cōngitāre quōmodo alteram viam ad istum rītum reperīre possīs.”

source: “Why must I?” Franca responded, clearly astonished.
target: “Cur mihi hoc faciendum sit?” Franca respondit, manifeste obstupefacta.

source: Lumian chuckled. “Have you noticed that all the high-ranking members of the Demoness Sect are Demonesses?
target: Lumian subrīdē dīxit: “Animadvertīstī omnes summōs gradūs membrōrum Sēctae Demonissārum esse Demonissās?

source: Do you think it’s because they can’t get their hands on the Iron-blooded Knight potion formula and Beyonder characteristics?”
target: Putāsne id esse, quoniam manibus illīs formulam poculī ēquitōrum sanguīne ferreōrum et proprietātēs “Beyonder” adipisci nōn licet?

source: “But the Demoness Sect doesn’t prohibit Demonesses from switching to the Hunter pathway…”
target: “Sed Sēctio Demonissārum Demonissās nōn prohibet ut ad viam Venatoris mutentur…”

source: “That’s indeed a contradiction,” Lumian speculated.
target: “Id certe est contrārietās,” Lumian coniectāvit.

source: “I suspect that those angelic-tier Demonesses can’t find higher Sequence Hunter pathway Beyonder characteristics to change back into men, so they’re not keen on seeing their subordinates regain themselves.
target: “Suspiciō has Demonissās, quae in ordinum angelicō collocantur, proprietātēs “Beyonder” viae Venatoris superiōrēs ad rēs in vīrōs retransmutandō reperīre nōn posse, ideo nōn appetītās videntēs subditōs suōs iterum se recipere.”

source: It has become an unspoken rule. You know, most of the high-ranking Demonesses are twisted in spirit, psychopathic, and enjoy seeing others in pain while hating to see them happy.”
target: Iam factum est regula tacīta. Scīs, plērīque ex summīs Demonissārum gradibus animīs corruptīs, psychopāticīs sunt et delectantur videndī alios in dolōre, simulque nolunt vidēre eos laetōs.

source: According to the intelligence Lumian and Franca received from Madam Magician and Madam Judgement, starting from Sequence 4, Hunters and Demonesses could switch pathways, with gender determined by the highest Sequence attained, and consuming potions of the same Sequence but from neighboring pathways to enhance one’s strength could cause significant problems.
target: Secundum notitiās quas Lumian et Franca a Domina Magica et Domina Judiciō recepērunt, ab Sequentia IV Venatōrēs et Demonissae viās mutāre poterant, cum genus determināretur ex summā Sequentiā attingentī, et potiōnēs eiusdem Sequentiae ex viis vicīnīs ad robōrem augendum sumendī gravia problemāta afferre possent.

source: Franca was silent for a long moment before saying, “If I digest the Affliction potion and still haven’t found an alternative to the Despair ritual, I’ll request to end my mission with the Demoness Sect from Madam Judgement. She should understand and wouldn’t allow me to carry out something like spreading a horrific plague.”
target: Franca diu siluit, antequam dīxit: “Sī poculum Afflictionis consumam et adhūc alternāviam viam ad rītum Desperatiōnis invenīre nōn possim, petam ut mīsae meae cum Sēctā Demonissārum ab Domina Judiciō finem imponam. Ea intellegere dēbet et nōn sinet mihi aliquid simile pestilentiam horribilem dissemināre.”

source: After saying this, Franca relaxed and muttered, “Besides, wouldn’t it be odd if Jenna becomes an Iron-blooded Knight and I remain a Demoness by then?”
target: Post hōc dictō, Franca se relaxāvit et submurmurāvit: “Praetereā, nonne mirum esset, sī Jenna fīeret ēques sanguīne ferreōrum et ego tunc manerem Demonissa?”

source: “Life is short, why not give it a try?” Lumian jested.
target: “Vīta brevis est, cur nōn conārī?” Lumian iocātus est.

source: Before Franca could react, Lumian leaped over the sofa with a stride and headed out the door.
target: Priusquam Franca potuīsset reagere, Lumian sōfā super saltāvit et per iānua exiēvit.

source: Bursts of black flames shot through the wooden door, chasing after Lumian’s back but gradually veering off target and dissipating into the air.
target: Flammae nigrāntēs per iānua līneā eruptae sunt, sequentes Lumianī tergum, sed paulatim a scōpō devīantes et in aere dissipantes.

source: Franca’s curse still rang clear in Lumian’s ears, “If you have what it takes, try it yourself!”
target: Maledictiō Francae adhūc clarē in auribus Lumianī resonābat: “Sī has facultātēs possīdās, conāre ipse!”

source: With a grin, Lumian stepped out into the street.
target: Subrīdē, Lumian in vīam exiēvit.

source: Watching Ludwig eat, he pulled up a chair opposite him and casually asked, “What ingredients or spices are needed for the third method of cooking those umbilical remains?”
target: Vidēns Ludovicum mandūcāre, sedem contrā eum arripuit et leviter quaesīvit: “Quae ingrediēnta aut species condimentōrum necessāriā sunt ad tertiam viam coquendī illās reliquiās umbilicālēs?”

source: By the side, Lugano was taken aback. “What umbilical remains?”
target: Ad lātus, Lugano stupēfactus exclamāvit: “Quae reliquiās umbilicālēs?”

source: Lumian smiled. “The umbilical remnant of the Child of God that Father Montserrat was carrying.”
target: Lumian subrīdē respondit: “Reliquiae umbilicāles Puerī Dei, quarum Pater Montserrat portābat.”

source: Lugano’s expression froze.
target: Vultus Lugānī congelātus est.
